title: Richard Doty's father involved in Area 51 and UFOs
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Richard Doty's father involved in Area 51 and UFOs, about an unknown time at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: His own father was uh I don't know all the details but was deeply involved in Area 51 and with UFOs.
I think his father worked at Area 51. Are you familiar with that history? Dolan told me that.
tellings.difference: Told by the host second hand from Dolan, and leaves out the father's UFO involvement.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Doty's father worked at Area 51, and the host credits Dolan, who tells the existing story.

plain: Richard Dolan, a historian who writes about UFOs, says that Richard Doty, a former Air Force agent who appears in many UFO stories, had a father who was "deeply involved in Area 51 and with UFOs." Area 51 is a secret US Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. Dolan admits he doesn't know the details, and the podcast host Jesse Michels later repeated the story on another episode, citing Dolan, but mentioned only the father's work at Area 51.
